findingClass: a completed prospectus-family extraction yields no issuer ratio and names no cause - the reader stopped being called (or never was) and nothing anywhere said so
failThreshold: any COMPLETED RHP/DRHP/PROSPECTUS document stored at or after RATIO_FIXED_EXTRACTOR_VERSION (extract_filing.py@2026-09-27) that, judged from its OWN E9 evidence (not financial_data.current_ratio): read a current ratio whose E9 ratioRead.current_ratio.period differs from latest_statement_period, or has no recorded period, or lies outside 0-50; OR claims ratio_note_not_in_document while ratioRead.current_ratio.current_ratio_line_pages lists a page printing a 'Current Ratio' line with 2+ decimals (or records no page evidence); OR reports ratio_row_not_in_note; OR names no/unaccepted reason (quick_ratio's balance_sheet_inputs_absent never excuses it). A named refusal (headings unreadable, heading/value count differs, latest period not printed, rows disagree, out of range, basis differs from the statement, statement period unknown) is REFUSED: judged, counted, not a FAIL. Older versions are PENDING re-read. A FAIL is tracked on #1179. Verdict: scripts/lib/ratio-yield-verdict.mjs
unverifiableWhen: no document in the population has been stored by the fixed reader yet (every one is pending re-read), or no prospectus-family document has completed extraction since the wiring date
why: scraper/scripts/financial_ratios.py merged in #638 with ZERO importers: correct, unit-tested, and never invoked, so every document produced null ratios in silence. A unit test proves the reader reads; only an audit over real rows proves it is still being CALLED. This is the same class as item 8a's peer locator, which was merged into TypeScript where nothing would ever call it. The check deliberately accepts a RECORDED REASON as a pass, because a document with no ratio note in it is a fact about the document, not a defect - what is never acceptable is an absence with no cause (signal-ownership.md R1: a number is not a reading). #771 narrowed the accepted reason: the old any-token match over the whole E9 text would pass every document once E9 carried reasons, because quick_ratio always records balance_sheet_inputs_absent; and ratio_row_not_in_note meant a printed row the reader missed on all four real prospectuses measured (A-One Steels RHP + DRHP, German Green Steel, Green Asia Impex), since the current ratio is a mandatory Schedule III row.
locatorNote: Population: documents extracted on or after the wiring date (RATIO_WIRING_MERGED_AT, default 2026-09-16). Judged: only those whose stored extractor_version is at or after RATIO_FIXED_EXTRACTOR_VERSION - compared by the stored version string, not a date, because staging re-read 9 documents at extract_filing.py@2026-09-26 with the OLD reader (A-One Steels RHP + DRHP null, German Green Steel a stale older-year 1.03). The rest are corrected by the pipeline's own re-read after the version bump, never by a repair. #771 round 3 (independent review 2026-09-27): the reader chooses the column by its period heading (the statement period of the stored net worth/EPS), records that period in E9 ratioRead, and the verdict asserts it - replacing the round-2 'not checked: no ratio_year'. Still not checked: the basis comparison runs only when both the ratio header and the P&L page state a basis; the verdict cannot tell a correct refusal from an over-strict one (the REFUSED count is shown so a rise is visible).
